visuals.prompt: Calm, atmospheric, non-graphic. Wide establishing view of a fictional 1980s subtropical coastal city at dusk: pastel art-deco hotels along a beachfront boulevard, palm silhouettes, the first neon signs flickering on in pink and teal, a single speedboat wake heading out across the calm bay toward open sea. Signs are abstract glowing shapes with no letters.

Somber, non-graphic. The Corporal from the reference sheet, in his olive army field jacket, standing alone at dawn outside the chain-link fence of a military airbase, hangars and palm trees behind him, looking back over his shoulder.

Somber, non-graphic. The Corporal from the reference sheet, in civilian clothes, sitting alone on a plastic chair in an empty hospital corridor at night, elbows on his knees, rain streaking the window beside him. Quiet grief.

Tense, non-graphic. The Corporal from the reference sheet, now in his pale blue civilian shirt, two years older, waiting at a folding table on a dark harbor pier at night, a closed briefcase in front of him, harbor lights and a moored freighter behind.

Somber, investigative, non-graphic. Surreal editorial illustration: an enormous brass clockwork mechanism whose gears are built from miniature city blocks, palm trees, hotel towers and neon tubes, glowing softly at dusk. At its center sits a single empty leather executive chair under a spotlight. Wide composition, deep perspective.
